title: ultraviolet totems in the dark
story: Tribal drums carry the outro at 78 bpm: a grid of ultraviolet-tinted totems turns on the room. Every low tom pushes the camera in with an exposure flash, every high drum snaps the contrast and shakes, every mid hit lifts the highlights. The camera steps between stations every two beats. At 6098 the drums run out, the camera recentres, then pulls back while the light fades and the room dims.
